name_input: M/s SARJAK CONTAINER LINES PRIVATE LIMIT
court_cases: Multiple civil/commercial and tax matters found on Indian Kanoon (21 documents total for the name). Party role and status: (1) M/s Sarjak Container Lines Pvt. Ltd. vs M/s KLR Industries Ltd. — Telangana High Court, 08.08.2018 — company as PETITIONER (arbitration-related). (2) Sarjak Container Lines Pvt. Ltd. vs Navemar De Mexico S.A. de C.V. — Supreme Court of India, Arb. Pet. (Civil) No. 54/2024, hearings 09.09.2024 and 30.09.2024 — company as PETITIONER (appointment of arbitrator). (3) Reliance Industries Limited vs Sarjak Container Lines Private Limited — Bombay High Court, Arbitration Application No. 491 of 2026, CNR HCBM020195222026, order dated 23.10.2026 — company as RESPONDENT. (4) Sarjak Container Lines Pvt. Ltd. vs Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 3(1)(1) Mumbai — Bombay High Court, Writ Petition No. 4633 of 2022, orders 25.04.2022, 25.07.2023 and 26.09.2023 — company as PETITIONER (tax writ). (5) Commissioner of Service Tax VI Mumbai vs Sarjak Container Lines Pvt. Ltd — Supreme Court, appeal No. 1663/2019, listed 19.01.2021 and 03.02.2022 — company as RESPONDENT (service-tax dispute). All are ordinary commercial, tax and arbitration litigation; no criminal proceedings found. Per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds.
news_risk: No sanctions, regulatory action or adverse media found. Note: the OFAC SDN/consolidated list search tool could not be queried programmatically (interactive form returned an error page), and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable during this session, so sanctions screening is INCOMPLETE rather than negative — recommend a manual re-screen of OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List before onboarding. No negative press located.
rf_supply: Yes — evidenced by the company's own published network page (https://www.sarjak.com/our-network/), which lists a dedicated commercial desk for 'Russia, Baltic, Black Sea CIS & Caspian Sea' with named staff and Russian mobile numbers: Yuri Gordeev, Principal Representative – Business Development (+7 985 2208182) and Nikolay Gordeev, Deputy General Manager – Business Development (+7 985 2206699). The homepage global-footprint map also marks Russia as a covered market. This is a declared, staffed Russia/CIS service line, not a one-off. No specific shipment, B/L or customs record for Russia/CIS was located in this session, so the actual volume and dates of RF-bound cargo remain unverified.
note: Risk-only review. Company is a Mumbai-based project logistics / ODC-OOG container operator founded 2003 (Chairman & MD Ashish Sheth; CEO Supal Shah), part of the Saksham Group. Sanctions exposure: no hit identified, but screening was not completed due to tool failure — treat as unverified, not cleared. Litigation: five identified matters (Telangana HC 2018, Supreme Court Arb. Pet. 54/2024, Bombay HC Arb. App. 491/2026 with Reliance Industries as applicant, Bombay HC tax writ 4633/2022, Supreme Court service-tax appeal 1663/2019) — all civil/tax/arbitration, no criminal cases; neutral per rule 2. Credit rating: not public / not found — null. RF/CIS exposure is the material risk flag: an openly advertised Russia–Baltic–Black Sea–CIS desk with two named representatives on Russian numbers. Recommend enhanced due diligence on RF-bound cargo documentation and end-use, and a manual sanctions re-screen. Legal identity, HS codes and shipment volumes deliberately not researched per role scope.
